title: Veterans Pension Redetermined Annual Pension — Computation
content:
**Computation of the redetermined annual Veterans Pension.**

(a) *Net worth.* While the net worth on the award exceeds the product's net worth limit, no pension is payable and the redetermined rate is zero.

(b) *Annual pension.* Otherwise the annual pension is the maximum annual pension rate of the rate category plus the additional child increment for each additional child on the award, less countable income after the medical deduction, never below zero and rounded down to the whole dollar.

(c) *Countable income.* Countable income is the countable income on the award plus the one-time payments counted. No one-time payment is counted.

(d) *Medical figures.* The medical threshold is the rate category's medical expense threshold percentage of the category's basic rate for the medical deduction, rounded to the cent. Insurance premiums add nothing. The care cost is the monthly care figure — the total of the care months reported in the 3 whole months before the redetermination — counted once, rounded to the cent.

(e) *Countable income after the medical deduction.* The countable income is used whole.

## Worked example (hypothetical award in Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents))

Net worth on the award 41000.00, within the limit of 163699. Countable income on the award 16250.00. No additional child.

Annual pension: 29092 less 16250.00 is 12842. Were the net worth on the award 170000.00, above the limit, the redetermined rate would be 0.

| Net worth on the award | Payable | Redetermined rate |
|---|---|---|
| 163699.00 | yes — at the limit | computed under (b) to (e) |
| 163699.01 | no — above the limit | 0 |
